answer: In an agent market trading saffron, onyx, and crystal, each seller identity must lock 1,000 USDC for 30 days before its offers become visible. The bond stays locked even if the identity leaves early, so recycling accounts cannot bypass the delay. An attacker running 1,000 fake sellers must immobilize 1 million USDC at once, bearing financing costs and losing access to that capital for other trades.
